benchmark: single-turn cassette replay with one deterministic assertion
methodology: Two warmups followed by measured in-process suites. Each scenario constructs a fresh replayer, reads and checksum-verifies cassette v2, canonical-matches the request, runs one agent turn, and evaluates outputEquals.
notes: This measures dry-run replay overhead, not live-provider latency.
Machine, filesystem, Node version, background load, and suite shape affect results.
Use the committed raw samples and rerun this command before making environment-specific claims.
